gemini.value: The Spring Valley quarantine notice took effect on June 16, 2026, newly flagging 3 loads (SR-1010, SR-1016, and SR-1023) for a total of 3 newly flagged shipments. The notice covers a generated zone of about 63.6 sq mi (official: 76.0 sq mi) affecting 22.5 acres of commercial avocado agriculture. Current shipment statuses show 5 need review, 4 are unclear pending a human check, 4 have no flag as they are not a host, and 12 have no flag because they are outside the zone. Operations must account for these changes, noting that 16 of 17 citations have been verified.
